rights_pending_required.models/mmr/mmr_classifier_best.pth: Required production MMR weight, shipped exactly as in main. No longer NotLicensed: the owner's rights in it are licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later on main (2026-11-27 model plan A, PR #559, docs/licensing/REPOSITORY_LICENSE_OPTIONS.md section 3); third-party rights in its initialization weights and score-derived training data are not relicensed (NOTICE, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Kept in this register so the rights basis of this shipped weight stays recorded with the payload audit, which requires every entry to name a selected file; a portable build is distributed only from a formally licensed version or under a separate written grant (#505/#508/#553)
